title: test(research): certify V45's frozen-owner invoice obstruction
body:
## Summary

V45's local saving does not survive PR2942's original owner-bin assignment. This source-bound audit grants free compaction inside those bins and charges their actual remaining capacity. All 16 endpoint subsets have a strictly higher complete recursive moment for every positive saving parameter.

```text
both literal parent words + 61 V45 frame edits
  all 16 endpoint subsets
original T74 role-to-bin assignment
  full source windows, 271728 roles, 149184 bins
exact local delta + exact idle delta
  equal rank mass, strictly worse moment for every a > 0
```

The joint difference is `1038 H1 + 6807 H2 + 3996 H3 - 6660 H4`. All positive ranks are below four and their rank mass equals the negative term, giving a short exact proof without surrogate prices or numerical roots.

Task `independent-moment`, **refined** to the fixed-parent complete invoice. Scientific base `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`; refreshed main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. The refresh changes workflow guidance; all ten scientific inputs and the selected record are unchanged. Parent #2942 is pinned at `a027b0f6fdb0ab2b42ba10fc31b53960166bf2bf`; construction #2979 at `be191346391661f4d35fc0d1508d0a6029572576`.

[Proof, scope and reproduction](research/rank7-v45-frozen-owner-invoice/README.md), [task and exact heads](research/rank7-v45-frozen-owner-invoice/TASK.json), [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18978871).

## Evidence

- **Before:** #2993 certifies the local V45 identity and reproduces a +22972-unit guide margin for all four endpoints, while explicitly leaving the actual idle tariff unresolved. **After:** independently reading the original fill finds 2370 new H1 and 147 new H2 idle children. Adding them gives the complete losing histogram above. This concerns the old assignment, not #2979's different final packing.
- Both provider frame recounts, all 16 subsets, complete parent invoice, availability windows and geometric capacity checks pass. Seven behavioral groups reject semantic geometry/frame/invoice/sign failures and corrupted source exports; optimized execution keeps the checks enabled.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, CPython 3.14.8 checks, Ruff, warning-as-error execution, two internal read-only reviews and committed-byte verification pass locally on macOS arm64. Hosted CI is separate.
- Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-v45-frozen-owner-invoice`.

Nearest work is #2993's local frame audit, #2987/#3010's changed-pattern packing checks, and #3006/#3008's native endpoint/event checks. This adds the original parent assignment's independently reconstructed complete idle invoice and exact moment-sign theorem.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Only one new opt-in research package. Frozen inputs, shared production code and the selected frontier are unchanged. No new supplier or kappa is claimed. Native semantics, arbitrary dirty-state restoration, physical movement/ownership, precision/tape, complete supplier/outer release and all-size obligations remain outside this audit.

## Open next questions

Join the published changed packing and native-event evidence to an independently checked physical invoice. Start with #2987's actual final fill and #3008's helper249/private953 inventory. The remaining native dependencies, ownership and precision costs block admission. The fixed-parent calculation is complete; no further search is proposed here.
